description: Tells whether a supplier is watched by this account and how the last check went: VIES outcome, whether the answer was authoritative, since when none has been obtained, and any anomalies detected. Requires an API key (free account at https://imperioutils.com/signup). Consumes no credits.

partita_iva.description: Supplier's Italian VAT number (Partita IVA, with or without IT prefix).

vat_number.description: Alias of `partita_iva` (Italian VAT number): the same value, accepted because other tools of this server use this name. If you send both names, the values must match.

name: guardian_supplier_status
title: Supplier watch status
